details.reasoning: The gold target is 6, while the predicted answer says 9 games, so the numerical answer contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. The question asks for wins after overcoming a deficit of more than 25 points, so wins after exactly 25 points do not count. 2. Citation [1] says there were nine wins after deficits of 25 points or more and lists the deficits. 3. Six listed deficits exceed 25 (33, 32, 28, 28, 27, and 26); the other three are exactly 25. Thus the citations support the gold target answer of 6.
